│> Flags · control bits     ││WHAT IS THIS SEGMENT SAYING?                                                             │
│  Sequence · this direction││                                                                                         │
│  ACK · other direction    ││Flags are independent on/off bits in the TCP header. Several can be set together.        │
│  Layers and stored bytes  ││Hexadecimal (0x) is a compact way to write those bits.                                   │
│                           ││                                                                                         │
│                           ││SYN [on] · when set: Start sequence numbering; consumes one sequence position.           │
│                           ││                                                                                         │
│                           ││ACK [off] · when set: The acknowledgement field is active; it describes the other        │
│                           ││direction.                                                                               │
│                           ││                                                                                         │
│                           ││PSH [off] · when set: Push data onward to the receiving application; not an HTTP message │
│                           ││boundary.                                                                                │
│                           ││                                                                                         │
│                           ││FIN [off] · when set: No more data from this sender; consumes one sequence position.     │
│                           ││                                                                                         │
│                           ││RST [off] · when set: Reset the connection abruptly; this does not explain the cause.    │
│                           ││                                                                                         │
